---
title: "Which category occurs most often, including ties?"
---

## What the question asks

Which category occurs most often, including ties?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Count categories with table().

2. Find max(counts).

3. Return every category whose count matches that maximum.

## Runnable example

```{r}
choice <- c("A","B","A","B","C","A","B")
counts <- table(choice)
print(counts)
print(names(counts)[counts==max(counts)])
```

## Interpret the result

A and B are tied as the most frequent categories, each appearing three times. Calling mode(choice) would not give this statistical result.

## Check before applying this to real data

Report tied categories when more than one category shares the maximum count.
